name: 7zip
description: LZMA2 archiver with 7z, ZIP, gzip, bzip2 support and AES encryption

7za.description: LZMA2 compression archiver with AES-256 encryption and multithreading
7za.usage:
7za a -t7z -mx=9 -mfb=64 -md=32m -ms=on backup.7z *.* # Maximum LZMA2 compression with 32MB dictionary
7za a -p -mhe=on secure.7z documents/ # Create encrypted archive with header encryption
7za x archive.7z -o./extracted/ -aoa -y # Extract with overwrite and no prompts
7za l -slt -ba archive.7z # List archive contents with technical details
7za t *.7z -r # Test integrity of all 7z archives recursively
7za a -sfx backup.exe *.txt # Create self-extracting executable archive
